source_law.text: Drivers of vehicles proceeding in opposite directions shall pass each other keeping to the right, and upon highways having width for not more than one line of traffic in each direction, each driver shall give to the other at least one-half of the paved portion of the highway as nearly as possible.

requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: Both exact selected opposing-pass constructions and CPU diagnostics present; original source review and physical realization remain pending.

activation_conditions: the subject meets a vehicle proceeding in the opposite direction

timing_requirements.requirement: judged at the meeting — the frames in which the two bodies are abreast
the approach to the meeting matters too: the half must be given up before the vehicles are abreast, not at the last instant

unresolved_judgment_calls: 'as nearly as possible' is a judgement element bounding the lateral offset
